text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Lima and the others were heading to the monster princess's castle, which was said to be located on the frontier.
text_block_list.orig_text: リマたちは辺境の地にあるという姫の居城へと向かっていた。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Hey, that over there... you think that's this princess's castle?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいあれ、
向こうに見えるのが姫の城じゃねえか？

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: We finally made it. The roads were rough, and we even got attacked by monsters... It was seriously tough.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ようやくね。
整備されていない道に
魔物まで襲ってきて、
本当に大変だったわ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: They didn't have to go buildin' it in a place this remote and lonely. And with all these monsters roamin' around, ain't no way we can just pop by for a visit.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こないな辺鄙で
寂しいとこに建てへんでもええのに。
魔物もぎょうさんおるし、
こんなんじゃ
おちおち遊びに来れへんわぁ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: No, we're not here to pay visits. What the hell did you think we were doing here, anyway?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
気軽に遊びに行くトコじゃねえだろ。
何しに行くつもりだよまったく。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Remember, we're up against a monster princess here. There are probably traps and monsters waiting for us in her castle. So be careful.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいか、
相手は魔物の姫だ。
その居城にはおそらく
罠や魔物が待ち構えてるはずだ。
気を引き締めていけよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, I just said that, but... THERE'S NOTHING HERE!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……って、言ったはいいけど、
何にもねぇじゃねえか！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: It's so mighty lonely inside the castle too. Should I be decoratin' it with some of my stuffed animals?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お城の中まで
えらい寂しいわぁ。
うちのぬいぐるみでも
飾ってあげまひょかね？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Princess, anything but that, please...
text_block_list.orig_text:
姫さん、
さすがにそれは止めてやれよ……

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: U-Um, when we actually face this monster princess, I'd like to talk to her first, rather than fighting her straight away...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あの、
魔物の姫に会ったら、
いきなり戦わないで
まずはお話ししてみたいんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey... that's pretty damn naive, don't you think?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおい、
そりゃまた呑気な話だな。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. However...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんなさい。
でも……

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: I sense a strong emotion from this castle that I can't quite put into words...
text_block_list.orig_text:
このお城からは、
上手く言葉にできない強い思いを感じるわ……

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: I don't know anything about the monster princess, but I feel like we might be able to understand each other somehow.
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物の姫のこと、
何にも分からないけど、
何となくだけど
理解しあえるんじゃないかって、
そんな気がするから。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Makoto-han, I'll be agreein' with her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マコトはん、
うちからも
おたのもうしあげます。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Princess, and you too, {0}... Well, I'm not looking to start a fight for no reason either. If we can talk this out, all the better.
text_block_list.orig_text:
姫さん、
それにおまえまで……
まあ、
こっちだって無闇やたらと戦いたいわけじゃねえんだ。
話し合いで解決するなら
それに越したことはねえ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: My oh my, Makoto-han be growin' right before my eyes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おやまあ、
マコトはんも
随分大人になりはったわ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Don't tease me. However, that all depends on how our opponent acts. If they attack without warning, I won't hesitate to strike back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
からかうなよ。
ただ、
それも相手の出方次第だ。
問答無用で来るなら、
迷わず迎撃させてもらうぞ。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: I know that. I won't be any more selfish than I already am.
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かってるわ。
これ以上のわがままは言えないわよね。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Oh my? Would ya look at that... now that's a mighty big door. Looks mighty suspicious too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おや？　
あれ
見とぉくれやす。
えらい大きな扉やわぁ。
いかにもな感じですわ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Yeah, most likely that monster princess is holed up in there. There may be some other monsters prepared to be set against us, so prepare yourself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
おそらく魔物の姫はこの中だ。
配下の魔物も控えているかもしれねえ、
覚悟しとけよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: ...Look! That throne in the back. Someone's there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……見ろ、
奥の玉座。
誰かいるぜ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Could that be the princess? Even though this is supposed to be a princess's room, it's so mighty lonely...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれがお姫はんでっしゃろか？
なんや、
お姫はんのお部屋なのに
ここも寂しいわぁ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Don't let your guard down. This is enemy territory. Intruders like us will find no advantage.
text_block_list.orig_text:
油断すんなよ。
ここは敵地だ、
侵入者に有利なことなんかありゃしねぇからな。

text_block_list.text: What are you so nervous about? There are no traps or minions here. Present yourselves already.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何をビクビクしておる。
罠も手下もおりはせんわ、
早く来るがいい。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: That voice just now...
text_block_list.orig_text: 今の声……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Yeah, there's no doubt about it. Must be that princess. I can't believe she's come to greet us all by herself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
姫って野郎に間違いねえ。
たった一人でお出迎えとは
なめられたもんだぜ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Who knows what might be poppin' out... monsters, snakes, or worse. Well then, let's get goin'.
text_block_list.orig_text:
鬼が出るか
蛇が出るか。
ほな、
行きまひょか。

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: I've grown tired of waiting. So you must be the girls Lloyd sent for me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ちくたびれたぞ。
お主らがロイドのよこした娘どもか。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: Is this really... a monster princess? She's way prettier than I pictured...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれが、
魔物の姫……？　
想像よりずっとキレイだわ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: ...I see. No wonder she calls herself a "princess". This girl is crazy strong. She doesn't need traps nor minions.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なるほど、
姫を名乗るだけのことはあるな。
こいつ、恐ろしく強いぞ。
罠も手下もいらねぇわけだ。

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Same goes for you. That Lloyd... seems he picked some real fighters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふん、
貴様もな。
ロイドのやつめ、
なかなか腕の立つ者をえらんだようだな。

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: There's one pesky man among you, but I'll overlook him. Now then... it is high time you showed me what you've got.
text_block_list.orig_text:
一人邪魔な男もおるが、
まあ勘弁してやろう。
それでは貴様らの力、
見せてもらうとするかの。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: W-Wait! Can we talk before we start fighting?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
待って！　
戦う前に
まずは話し合いましょ！

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: You cur, enough with the unfunny jokes. You wouldn't want that lovely face of yours ruined, would you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
貴様、
笑えぬ冗談はそれくらいにしておけよ？
そのおキレイな面を台無しにされたくはあるまい。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: Please... I really think we could understand each other. So...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お願い、
私たち
きっと分かり合えると思うの。
だから──

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: Didn't I just tell you? STOP FOOLING AROUND!
text_block_list.orig_text:
言ったであろう？　
冗談はやめろとな！

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: Ho... Not bad. You've got some skill after all. HOWEVER!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほう、
いい反応だ。
存外やるではないか。
だが！

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: Ah! {0}-kun!
text_block_list.orig_text: ああ！　{0}くん！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Tch, I knew it'd come down to this! Let's do this, Princess! ORA ORAAAAA!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちっ、
やっぱりこうなったか！　
やるぞ姫さん！
おらおらぁ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: I don't fancy fightin', but there's no helpin' it. Kururinpa~☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
けんかは好きやないけど、
仕方あらしまへんなぁ。
くるりんぱ～☆

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: Kuhaha! The lot of you are quite capable. Looks like you've clawed your way through more than a few hellish scrapes. Maybe... just maybe, you could stop me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
く
はは！　
強いな貴様ら。
相当な修羅場を潜り抜けてきたようだの。
貴様らなら
妾を止められるかもしれんのぉ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: There's no "maybe", we'll stop you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
かもじゃねえ、
止めんだよ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Once you calm down a touch, we'll let you have a lil' chat with Lima-han.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大人しゅうなったとこで
リマはんとお話ししてもらいますえ。

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: Don't bring trivial emotions into a battle! Come at me with the intent to kill!
text_block_list.orig_text:
戦いにつまらぬ感情を持ち込むでないわ！
妾を殺す気で来るがいい！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Damn it, she's definitely not someone you can go easy on! Princess!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くそっ、
たしかにこいつは加減なんかしていい相手じゃねえな！
姫さん！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Here I go~ Mira-cle Mahorin... Kururinpa~☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
行くで～
みらくるまほりん、
くるりんぱ～☆

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: I'LL PRESS ON! HAAAAAAAAAAH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
畳みかける！
はああああっ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: We got her... GUAAAAAAH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったか……
ぐあ！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Makoto-han?! EEEK!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マコトはん！？　
きゃあ！

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: That just now was good. But it doesn't seem like it's enough to stop me. You lot are too soft, going on about talking things out and all that sentimental nonsense.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今のはよかったぞ。
だが、
妾を止めるには足りんようだの。
話し合いだのなんだのと、
貴様らは甘すぎるのだ。

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: You should regret ever standing before me with such flimsy resolve!
text_block_list.orig_text: そんな覚悟で妾の前に立ったことを後悔するがいい！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: A-Ah, don't... it's mighty dangerous, my Darlin' Prince...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あかんどす、
王子はん……

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: You again. If all you're good for is shielding others, stay out of my way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
また貴様か。
盾になるしか能のない奴は引っ込んでおれ。

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: I have nothing to say to the lot of you, didn't I say that already! I... I have no choice but to do this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
貴様らと話すことなどないと言ってるであろうが！
妾には……
妾にはこうするしかないのだ！

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. So that's your stance. But let's see if you can still say such foolish things... after seeing this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
言うではないか。
それでは、
これを見てもそんな戯言が言えるか！

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: Th-That face...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
その顔……

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: What do you think? Disgusting, right? There's no way someone like me could ever understand humans.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうだ？　
醜かろう？
こんな妾が
人間と分かり合えるはずがなかろう。

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: You who were born beautiful... you could never understand my pain!
text_block_list.orig_text:
貴様らのように
美しく生まれた者に
妾の苦しみなど
分かるはずもない。

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: Now go back to Lloyd, and give him this message: "I'm coming to claim you."
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かったらロイドの元へ帰ってこう伝えろ。
貴様をもらいに行くとな。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: Ah, now I understand... The emotion I felt coming from this castle was loneliness.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
分かった……
このお城に感じた感情、
それは
孤独だったのね。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: I also look like a monster. I've been rejected before, so I understand how she feels...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も
見た目は魔物みたいなものだもん。
拒絶されてきたから、
彼女の気持ちはよく分かるわ……

text_block_list.name: リマ
text_block_list.text:
でも、
私は幸運にも
牧場のみんなや彼がいてくれた。
もしみんなに会えなかったら、
私も同じようになっていたかもしれない。
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
私は幸運にも
牧場のみんなや彼がいてくれた。
もしみんなに会えなかったら、
私も同じようになっていたかもしれない。

text_block_list.name: リマ
text_block_list.text:
もし
孤独が彼女を歪めてしまったなら、
私たちはきっと分かり合えるはずだわ！
text_block_list.orig_text:
もし
孤独が彼女を歪めてしまったなら、
私たちはきっと分かり合えるはずだわ！

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: Please! Let me talk to you again! Because I... I'm the same...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お願い、
もう一度お話しさせて！　
だって私も……

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: CEASE THIS FOOLISHNESS! If you really want me to listen to you, then you shall have to beat me first!
text_block_list.orig_text:
戯言をぬかすな！　
話を聞いてほしくば、
まずは妾に勝ってからだ！

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: Ugh, ugh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐ、
うぅ……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: She did it... You really did it, hey!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった……
やったな、
おい！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Whew... so Lima-han really was Lima-han. I'm so mighty shocked, I clean forgot I was hurt!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
リマはんは
リマはんやったんやね。
驚いて
痛みも
どこか行ってもうたわ。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: You two! I'm so glad you're both safe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人とも……
よかった、
無事だったのね。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: It'll take more than that to put me down. But you... that form of yours...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これくらいじゃくたばんねえよ。
しかしあんた、
その姿……

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: A-As expected, I'm scary, aren't I...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やっぱり怖い、
わよね？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you on about? You've got a strong build and a solid look, nothing wrong with that! You'd fit right in with Caon, seriously.
text_block_list.orig_text:
は？　
何言ってるんだ、
立派な体格にいい面構え、
大いに結構じゃねえか。
【自警団（カォン）】でも立派にやってけるぜ。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: That's... kind of a backhanded compliment, but thanks. I'm happy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと複雑な褒め言葉だけど、
うれしいわ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Anyway, Lima-han... what do we do 'bout this princess-han?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ところでリマはん、
こちらのお姫はん、
いかがします？

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: It's obvious. We'll talk. We won, so now it's okay, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
決まっているわ。
お話しするのよ。
私たちが勝ったんですもの、
いいわよね？

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. You're hopelessly soft... You'll regret not striking the final blow, mark my words.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふん、
どこまでも甘い奴め。
とどめを刺さなかったことをきっと後悔するぞ？

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: We're both soft, aren't we? If you'd been serious, I wouldn't have stood a chance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
甘いのはお互いさまでしょ？
だってあなたが本気になったら、
私なんか何もできなかったわよ。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: Besides, abducting Lloyd should have been easy for you. The only reason you didn't do it is because you're kind.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに
ロイドさんをさらうのだって
簡単だったはず。
そうしなかったのは、
あなたが優しいからよ。

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Don't talk like you know me. It's irritating.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……知った風な口をきくな、
腹立たしい。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: Hey, Princess. As you can see, this is my true self, I'm just like you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ、
姫さま。
見ての通り
これが私の本当の姿、
あなたと同じよ。

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Like me, huh. Even though we both have the form of beasts, you are so beautiful. However... I am ugly not only in appearance but also in my heart.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……同じなものか。
獣の姿同士なのに、
貴様はこんなにも美しい。
なのに
妾は
姿だけでなく
心まで醜い。

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: That's why I had no choice... This foolish plan was the only way I could get near Lloyd.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゆえに
妾はこんな愚かな方法でしか
ロイドに近付けなかったのだ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: I've been wondering about that, too. Even though you have such great power, I don't understand why you would choose a human noble.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはあたしも気になってたよ。
これだけ強い力があるのに、
わざわざ人間の貴族様を選ぶ理由が分からねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Makoto-han, folks say "love is blind", don't they? Once your heart's gone, things like race don't matter one bit. Ain't that right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
マコトはん、
「恋は盲目」って
いいはりますやろ？
好きになったら
種族の違いなんて
関係あらへんのや。
なあ？

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: Ah, uh... well...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ぅ……
その……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Oh ho, nailed it, didn't I? Hehe... I knew it. You really are a princess through and through.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらま、
図星やったわぁ。
ふふ、
やっぱり
お姫はんなんやな。

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: D-Don't tease me... The truth is, Lloyd is my benefactor and childhood friend.
text_block_list.orig_text:
か、
からかうな……
実は、
ロイドは妾の恩人にして
幼馴染なのだ。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: Ehhhh?! Another shocking truth has appeared!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ！　
それはまた驚きの事実だわ！

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: When I was young, I was caught in a human trap... but Lloyd, who was on a hunt at the time, saved me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
幼い時、
妾が人間の罠にかかったところを、
狩りでこの地を訪れたロイドに助けられたのだ。

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: After that, we met and played in secret. We were both young at the time. So we could get away with things like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それから
妾たちは人目を忍んで会い、
遊んだ。
お互い幼かったからの。
そういうこともできたのだ。

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: However, time passed, and Lloyd left this land, and our relationship came to an end. But I... never forgot about him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だが時が経ち、
ロイドがこの地を離れ
その関係も終わりを迎えた。
だが、
妾はずっと
ロイドのことが忘れられなかった。

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: In this deserted castle, I continued to think of him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰もいないこの城で、
あやつのことを思い続けたのだ。

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: Then, about a year ago, Lloyd returned as the master of that mansion. Unable to stay put any longer, I went to meet him, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして１年ほど前、
ロイドはあの館の主として戻ってきた。
いてもたってもいられず、
会いに行ったが……

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: The moment he saw me, I saw fear in his eyes. I knew in that instant... we could never go back to what we had.
text_block_list.orig_text:
妾を見た瞬間、
あやつの目に恐怖の色が浮かんだのだ。
もうあの頃のようにはできないのだと理解したわ……

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe so. But... what if he didn't remember even after that? The thought terrified me so much I couldn't stand it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……かもな。
だが、
それでも思い出してもらえなかったら？
怖くてたまらないのだ。

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: In that case, I might as well act like a monster. That's what I decided. I can't have a proper relationship with him in this ugly form.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それならいっそ
魔物らしく振舞ってやろう。
そう決めたのだ。
こんな醜い姿では
まともに付き合うなど
できはしないからな。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: Then, the reason you wanted a stronger and more beautiful woman brought here was...
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
美しくて強い女の子を連れてこさせたのは……

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: If she were to be stronger and more beautiful than me, I'd be able to give up, and most importantly, I could leave Lloyd in her care with peace of mind.
text_block_list.orig_text:
妾より
強くて美しい女性なら
諦めもつくし、
なにより
安心してロイドを任せられるからの。

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: Now, that's the end of my story. I've lost. My fate is in your hands, do as you like.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ、
話は終わりだ。
妾は負けた。
処遇は貴様らの好きにするがいい。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: I see. In that case... I'll have you meet Lloyd and talk to him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう。
それなら……
ちゃんとロイドさんに会ってお話しするのよ！

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: ...HUH?! Wh-Why would you say such a thing?! You cur, did you hear what I said?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はあ！？　
な、
何でそうなるのだ！
貴様、
妾の話聞いておったか！

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: You're not ugly at all. It's just... you've misused the courage you clearly hold. You are a girl, after all. Such things happen.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたは醜くなんかないわ。
ただ、
ちょっとだけ勇気の使い方を間違っただけ。
女の子だもん、
そういうことだってあるわよね。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: As long as your heart is still beautiful, you can still change. Therefore, once more... tell that man how you feel!
text_block_list.orig_text:
心が美しいままなら、
まだ変われるわ。
だからもう一度
あの人に思いを伝えるのよ！

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: N-No, that's...
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いや、
それは……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: As a fellow princess, allow me to be givin' you a warnin'. All maidens in love are princesses. And of course, they're also mighty beautiful.
text_block_list.orig_text:
同じ姫として
忠告させてもらいます。
恋する乙女は
みんなお姫はんや。
キレイに決まってはります。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: I understand all too well the feeling of not being able to be honest... W-Wait, I said nothing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
素直になれない気持ち、
あたしもよく分かる……
って、
な、
なんでもねえよ！

text_block_list.name: Monster Princess
text_block_list.text: You curs... Fine, I don't have the right to refuse anyway. If I'm going to be hated anyway, I'll confess openly and reach the same end!
text_block_list.orig_text:
貴様ら……
いいだろう、
どうせ妾に拒否権などないのだからな。
どうせ嫌われるなら
堂々と告白して嫌われてやるわ！
